editorial.principle: Vi beskriver händelser, lag, platser och trender – aldrig anklagelser mot enskilda. Om något kan tvinga fram en borttagning senare bygger vi inte in det från början.

compliance._note: Med jail/obits borttagna finns i praktiken ingen borttagningsmaskin att bygga. Kontakten finns ändå som god sed.

ai._tone_v2_note: Launched 2026-08-26 already enabled by default -- both existing towns' old-vs-new comparison has already been reviewed and approved (see NEEDS-HUMAN-REVIEW.md), no reason for a third town to launch on the older prompt path.
ai.tone_guidelines: Skriv som en påläst, glad granne. Kort, konkret, välkomnande. Fira det som är kul (nyöppningar, evenemang) utan att överdriva. Håll dig strikt till fakta i källdatan – hitta aldrig på detaljer, namn eller siffror. Ingen åsikt om politik/beslut, bara vad som händer och vad det betyder i klarspråk.

output._note: Undvik en tunn indexerad sida per post. Väv ihop till läsbara digests med kontext – bättre för läsaren OCH för AdSense (information gain istället för scaled content).

city_meetings._notes: CONFIRMED live 2026-08-26 (Broomfield launch research): City and County of Broomfield's Council meetings run on AgendaLink (Horizon Software), client slug literally 'broomfield'. GET https://api.agendalink.app/api/session/all/broomfield returns real JSON (id, board, room.address, scheduleTime, scheduleIso, clientId, status, agendaUrl), no auth token needed, supports ?month=YYYY-MM. Docs at docs.agendalink.app/docs/agenda-api. Do NOT confuse with broomfield.org/AgendaCenter -- that is a separate, older CivicPlus/CivicEngage module for boards/commissions, not Council itself. public_viewer corrected 2026-08-27: the API's own agendaUrl field returns sandbox.agendalink.app links (not horizon.agendalink.app, despite the earlier research note) -- used the API's own returned URL rather than guessing which domain is canonical. scrapers/parsers/agendalink_v1.py built and verified live 2026-08-27 (real substantive agenda-item content extracted, not just meeting metadata -- see /api/session/agenda/:id) -- enabled:true. Not yet built: /api/session/minutes/:id (approved-minutes follow-up, same idea as escribe_v1's PostMinutes/meeting_followups.py flow).

school_alerts_bvsd._notes: Serves Broomfield High School ('Eagles'). Research 2026-08-26: parts of bvsd.org run Finalsite, but the district's actual alerting tool is Apptegy (banner + email/text/app push), not exposed as RSS/JSON. Needs real research into whether Apptegy has any public feed before a parser is attempted -- do not assume the MVUSD Finalsite pattern transfers.

events._notes: CONFIRMED live 2026-08-26: Broomfield's recreation/library calendar runs on Vermont Systems WebTrac (city-branded 'B-REx'), confirmed live at cobroomfieldweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/ (search.html, iteminfo.html?Module=AR for activities, Module=FR for facilities). Vermont Systems documents a real JSON API but it requires an Authenticate/Login call with an API key + session ID -- not a bare discoverable endpoint the way Tockify's ICS export is for Moreno Valley. Public HTML pages are scrapable as a fallback if the API access isn't obtained. enabled:false until either (a) WebTrac API credentials are obtained from the city, or (b) an HTML-scrape parser is built and its robots.txt is checked.

weather._notes: NOAA/NWS is a nationwide API, same integration as both existing towns -- no Broomfield-specific work needed beyond real coordinates.

weather_alerts._notes: VERIFIED 2026-08-26 live: api.weather.gov/points/39.9205,-105.0866 returns county=.../zones/county/COC014 (Broomfield County), forecast office BOU (Boulder). Keyless, requires User-Agent, same as both existing towns.

traffic._notes: Research 2026-08-26: unlike Caltrans (fully open KML, no key), CDOT/COtrip's incident feeds (data.cotrip.org/xml/*.xml, catalogued at data.colorado.gov and manage-api.cotrip.org) require free developer registration and an API key/basic-auth-style credential -- confirmed real feeds exist (third-party tools like dfpc-coe/etl-cotrip-incidents already consume them), just not anonymous. enabled:false until the signup is done and a scrapers/parsers/cdot_v1.py is written mirroring traffic_v1.py's bbox-filtering approach.

facilities._notes: Same manual-curation mechanism as both existing towns (scripts/seed_facilities.py, no scraper). enabled:false because data/facilities/broomfield_co.json has not been hand-curated/verified yet -- do not fabricate library/park/city-hall addresses; someone needs to actually verify them (broomfield.org, library branch pages) before this flips to true, same discipline as the other two towns' 2026-08-03 verification note.

earnings_and_warn._notes: NEW source type, not yet wired into scrapers/runner.py's REGISTRY -- see NEEDS-HUMAN-REVIEW.md 'Broomfield launch, Workplace Watch earnings/WARN citation feature'. Unlike Moreno Valley's employer set, all three seeded Broomfield employers (Vail Resorts, Ball Corporation, Noodles & Company) are public companies -- CONFIRMED 2026-08-26: Vail Resorts (NYSE:MTN) HQ'd at 390 Interlocken Crescent, Broomfield, quarterly earnings releases Broomfield-datelined (e.g. Q1 FY26 released 2025-12-10); Colorado WARN Act notices are public record at cdle.colorado.gov/employers/layoff-separations/layoff-warn-list, and Vail Resorts' 2025-04-04 filing (HR Shared Services unit closure, Broomfield, 64 roles) is independently corroborated by multiple news outlets. This needs its own guardrail (citing a filed fact plainly is the OPPOSITE of validate_employer_hedging()'s job, which exists specifically to hedge aggregated review sentiment) and likely its own small table -- not an extension of the existing hedging pipeline. enabled:false until that guardrail + ingestion path exist.

workplace_watch._notes: Employer set: Vail Resorts, Ball Corporation, Noodles & Company (see data/employers/broomfield_co.json). Same Brave Search + hedging-guardrail mechanism as Moreno Valley's employers (Amazon/Skechers/Ross/Deckers/ALDI) -- reused as-is. ai_pipeline/workplace_watch_digest.py's Brave Search queries and grounding text were hardcoded to 'Moreno Valley' specifically; fixed 2026-08-26 to read the town's own display_name/state from cfg instead, so this works correctly for Broomfield without a Broomfield-specific code branch. Do not use Vail Resorts', Ball's, or Noodles' logos/brand marks anywhere on the site -- factual, attributed news coverage is fine, implying affiliation is not.
